topic: 45° Scan Range and Link Budget Calculations
consensus_response: The 45° scan range significantly impacts link budget calculations by balancing signal strength and reducing interference. A wider beamwidth benefits link margin, but it increases power requirements and complexity. A narrower beamwidth reduces path loss but increases power, requiring careful consideration of trade-offs. Real-world applications and future research directions can provide valuable insights for optimizing link budget calculations.
